questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a businessperson you admire. You should say: who this person is; what business they run; how you found out about them; and explain why you admire this person.

questions.text: Would you like to work for this person's company?
questions.say: Thank you. Would you like to work for this person's company?

questions.text: What skills do people need to run a successful business?
